newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto will not remarry - agency.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto will not remarry - agency.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto has no plans to remarry and rumours that he was waiting for the wedding of his youngest son first are false, his half-brother said.
The official Antara news agency quoted Probosutedjo, the president's half-brother, as saying on national television on Thursday night that Suharto, 75, was not considering marriage.
"It is completely slanderous and totally untrue," Probosutedjo was quoted as saying.

Jakarta has been thick with rumours for several weeks that Suharto was waiting for the marriage of his youngest son, Hutomo Mandala Putra, to remarry. Mandala Putra was married to a descendant of Javanese royalty on Wednesday.
Suharto's wife of 48 years, Tien, died of a heart attack in April 1996.
Probosutedjo said he had checked with Suharto and was told by the president that the rumours were untrue.
